200.body: Poland Seeks NATO Reinforcements After Russian Missiles and Drone Breach Its Airspace by EUToday Correspondents November 20, 2026 written by EUToday Correspondents November 20, 2026 Polish Defence Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz. 31 Poland has announced plans to request additional NATO military support after two suspected Russian missiles and a jet-powered drone entered its airspace during a large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine on Friday, 20 November . NATO launched Eastern Sentry in September 2025 , following incursions by Russian drones into Polish airspace. Renewed pressure on NATO’s eastern flank The latest violations follow a series of incidents involving Russian military aircraft and drones near NATO territory since the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

400.body: Poland expects to sign a contract early next year with US firms Westinghouse Electric and Bechtel to build its first nuclear power plant, the head of the state-owned company behind the project said. The three parties had previously said they hoped to sign by the end of this year, but Woszczyk said the delay would not affect the project's timeline.Poland's nuclear plant to have three AP1000 reactorsThe plant, located on the Baltic coast in Pomerania, will have three Westinghouse AP1000 reactors with a combined capacity of 3,750 megawatts. Under current forecasts, the plant will provide about 10% of Poland's electricity.Woszczyk said PEJ plans to buy nuclear fuel from several suppliers and store it on site so it is never dependent on a single source.Poland seeks energy independence after break with RussiaPoland historically relied on Russia for much of its energy, but it moved to end that dependence after Moscow's 2022 invasion of Ukraine.

500.body: 0:00 0:00 Normal 1.25x 1.5x Like Reading list Google has announced it is donating Agent Substrate and gVisor to the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) , placing two important components of its AI agent infrastructure under vendor-neutral open-source governance. Together, the projects target different layers of agent infrastructure, from isolated code execution to managing agent lifecycles and coordinating large-scale training workloads. Google developed Agent Substrate to address these limitations by separating agent state (actors) from the compute resources (workers) used to execute it. Google's contribution is to combine secure execution with an agent-aware orchestration model and place the resulting technologies within an open ecosystem.
